      A Prayer for the Fighters

      Before every card, we pray.

      Lord,

      Watch over every fighter who steps through the ropes this weekend. Give them strength for the rounds ahead, clear their minds and steady their hands, and keep them from harm.

      Protect the referees, the doctors and the corner teams who hold their safety in their hands.

      Heal the fighters who have been hurt in this sport, and comfort the families who watch and worry every time their fighter walks out.

      Let the fights be good and honest, let every fighter show what they have trained for, and let every one of them walk out of the ring on their own feet.

      In Jesus' name we pray. Amen.

      Pray for the fighters on the next card, and for their families.
